g.text: The operator asks “what is broken?”. The account manager
asks “who is affected?”. The dashboard had to answer both
By the time I filter the sheet, the customer has
No way to group devices by BTS
“Just tell me which tower is down.”
“One wrong bulk push and I’m on
Filters city by city, copies device IDs
Overloaded by red rows, anxious on
My customer shouldn’t hear about an outage
Waits on the NOC for every
“I need a screen I can show the
Emails the NOC, waits a day, pastes
